title: Can this benchmark measure context? Diagnostics for context-dependent code review (code, benchmark, results)
description: Benchmark generator for cross-file Python defects with AST-verified evidence, safe twins, the held-constant-evidence experiment (eight arms, three model families, two serialisations, two judges), the c-CRAB retrieval runs, the frozen per-call records, the analysis scripts, and the paper sources. python scripts/reproduce.py recomputes every reported number from the frozen records without network access.
